python - << 'PY'
from sphinx.application import Sphinx
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile, textwrap, shutil, re

tmp = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
src = tmp/'src'
src.mkdir()
(src/'conf.py').write_text("extensions=['sphinx.ext.autodoc']\nmaster_doc='index'\n")
(src/'example.py').write_text(textwrap.dedent('''
__all__ = []

def foo():
    "docstring"

def bar():
    "docstring"

def baz():
    "docstring"
'''))
(src/'index.rst').write_text(textwrap.dedent('''
.. automodule:: example
   :members:
'''))

out = tmp/'_build'; doctree = tmp/'_doctree'
app = Sphinx(srcdir=str(src), confdir=str(src), outdir=str(out), doctreedir=str(doctree), buildername='html', status=None, warning=None, freshenv=True)
app.build()
html = (out/'index.html').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
print('contains example.foo anchor:', 'example.foo' in html)
print('contains example.bar anchor:', 'example.bar' in html)
print('contains example.baz anchor:', 'example.baz' in html)
print('py function def blocks present:', bool(re.search(r'<dl class="py function">', html)))
shutil.rmtree(tmp)
